verdict.rationale: Segment's documented Public API supports token-authenticated CRUD over workspace resources such as Sources, Destinations, Warehouses and Tracking Plans, which allows headless, scripted management. Its reference also publishes an OpenAPI spec, SDKs, rate limits, pagination and versioning, all of which suit automated callers. The evidence never ties this to CI pipelines or names a dedicated headless tool, so the story is only partly delivered. Missing for 10: an official CLI or infrastructure-as-code tooling, documented CI/CD integration guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless automation in practice.
